changes.before: On a 12-month basis, inflation has declined recently and, like the measure excluding food and energy prices, is running somewhat below 2 percent.
changes.after: On a 12-month basis, overall inflation and the measure excluding food and energy prices have declined and are running below 2 percent.

changes.before: the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1 to 1-1/4 percent.
changes.after: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 1 to 1-1/4 percent.

changes.before: The Committee currently expects to begin implementing a balance sheet normalization program this year, provided that the economy evolves broadly as anticipated.
changes.after: The Committee expects to begin implementing its balance sheet normalization program relatively soon, provided that the economy evolves broadly as anticipated;

changes.before: The Committee is maintaining its existing policy of reinvesting principal payments
changes.after: For the time being, the Committee is maintaining its existing policy of reinvesting principal payments

changes.before: Job gains have moderated but have been solid, on average, since the beginning of the year
changes.after: Job gains have been solid, on average, since the beginning of the year

changes.before: Voting against the action was Neel Kashkari, who preferred at this meeting to maintain the existing target range for the federal funds rate.

parsed.rationale: Removing 'somewhat' from the inflation description is a dovish tilt, and the pause after the June hike was expected. This is offset by the hawkish signal that balance-sheet runoff will begin 'relatively soon', leaving the net signal roughly unchanged.
